# Edit a file and check the edit

Edit a file and check the edit. Use when a task changes one file and the change must be seen to have applied.

## Steps

1. I make the change in {{source-file}}.

   ```
   edit({{"path":"{{source-file}}"}})
   ```

2. I read {{source-file}} again to check that the edit applied, rather than retrying a shell edit.

   ```
   read({{"path":"{{source-file}}"}})
   ```
</procedure>
